Subject: SummitAI trial: success metrics, access orchestration & owner roster

Hi Alex / Luis —

Great conversation today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed concrete next steps so we can get the trial moving this week.

Key success criteria (as discussed)
- Ingest latency: < 250ms P50 for 128-token requests against our BETA config
- Cost baseline: per-request cost under the estimate in the MPA (see attached)
- Functionality: generation + tool-calling prototype for 2 customer workflows
- Quality: human eval pass rate >= 85% on the three prompt sets you shared

Proposed 3-week evaluation plan
1) Day 0–2: Access & infra handoff — API keys, SSO invites, and IP allowlist
2) Week 1: Baseline tests (latency / cost) + sample integration with one internal workflow
3) Week 2: Expanded test with two workflows and human-eval collection
4) Week 3: Final metrics review, regressions, and go/no-go decision

Ownership (suggested)
- SummitAI: Integration engineer (Luis) — implementation and sample data
- Redwood: Tessa — PM for trial; Stephanie (cc) — SSO & invites; Vivek (cc) — security/certs and IP allowlist setup

Immediate asks (can we action these by end of day Tue?):
- Confirm the SummitAI integration engineer who will receive SSO invites and API keys
- Send the CI/CD environment IP ranges to allowlist (if available)
- Sign the Mutual Participation Agreement draft I attached (redwood_mpa_v1.pdf) — this is just standard trial terms

Attachments: redwood_mpa_v1.pdf (trial MPA)

If that looks good I'll open the SSO invites and provision a short-lived API key for the first engineer.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
